name: Tayama Saki
source:
A schoolgirl attending an ordinary metropolitan school. After the death of her mother, she was taken under the care of the Tayama family that her mother had remarried into.

She is bright, positive and proactive. However, her acting shortsightedly also leads to many missteps.
